examples: Citizens voted in favor of constitutional reform in a nationwide referendum.

words.definition_vi: Lệnh trừng phạt kinh tế quốc tế
words.definition_en: A threatened penalty for disobeying a law or rule, or trade embargo.
examples: The UN Security Council imposed economic sanctions on the rogue regime.

words.definition_vi: Hiệp ước quốc tế chính thức
words.definition_en: A formally concluded and ratified agreement between states.
examples: The nations signed a non-proliferation nuclear treaty.

words.definition_vi: Đơn phương (Một phía tự quyết)
words.definition_en: Performed by or affecting only one person, group, or country without agreement.
examples: The nation announced a unilateral withdrawal from the trade accord.

words.definition_vi: Quyền phủ quyết
words.definition_en: A constitutional right to reject a decision or proposal made by a law-making body.
examples: The permanent member exercised its veto power in the UN Council.

words.definition_vi: Nhà nước phúc lợi xã hội
words.definition_en: A system whereby the state protects health and well-being of citizens.
examples: Nordic countries are recognized models of the modern welfare state.

words.definition_vi: Chính sách ngăn chặn tư tưởng bài ngoại
words.definition_en: Government strategies combating discrimination against foreign immigrants.
examples: The civic integration program established an anti-xenophobia policy.

words.definition_vi: Nhượng bộ một phần chủ quyền cho liên minh
words.definition_en: Cede specific state regulatory authority to international supranational bodies.
examples: Member nations yield sovereignty on common currency regulations.

words.definition_vi: Xung đột do tư tưởng cực đoan
words.definition_en: Confrontation driven by uncompromising ideological fanaticism.
examples: Diplomatic mediators prevented an ideological zealotry-clash.

words.definition_vi: Độc tài chuyên chế
words.definition_en: Favoring or enforcing strict obedience to authority at expense of freedom.
examples: Citizens protested against the authoritarian regime's emergency decrees.

words.definition_vi: Lá phiếu bầu cử
words.definition_en: A system of voting secretly and in writing on a particular issue.
examples: Voters cast their secret ballots at local polling stations.

words.definition_vi: Hiến pháp quốc gia
words.definition_en: A body of fundamental principles according to which a state is governed.
examples: The national constitution guarantees freedom of speech and religion.

words.definition_vi: Kẻ mị dân cơ hội chính trị
words.definition_en: A political leader who seeks support by appealing to popular desires rather than logic.
examples: The demagogue stirred up public anger with xenophobic speeches.

words.definition_vi: Toàn thể cử tri cử tuyển
words.definition_en: All the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election.
examples: Over 75% of the national electorate turned out on election day.

words.definition_vi: Thủ thuật đọc diễn văn câu giờ tại nghị viện
words.definition_en: An action such as a prolonged speech that obstructs progress in a legislative assembly.
examples: The opposition senator mounted a 14-hour filibuster to delay the vote.

words.definition_vi: Thủ thuật vẽ lại ranh giới khu vực bầu cử vụ lợi
words.definition_en: Manipulate the boundaries of an electoral constituency so as to favor one party.
examples: Politicians were accused of gerrymandering districts to ensure victory.

words.definition_vi: Mang tính nhân đạo quốc tế
words.definition_en: Concerned with or seeking to promote human welfare.
examples: The UN dispatched humanitarian aid convoys to famine zones.

words.definition_vi: Đương kim tổng thống / viên chức tại nhiệm
words.definition_en: The holder of an office or post.
examples: The incumbent president announced his candidacy for a second term.

words.definition_vi: Chính quyền quân sự đảo chính
words.definition_en: A military or political group that rules a country after taking power by force.
examples: The military junta suspended the constitution following the coup.

words.definition_vi: Chế độ quan chức tham nhũng vơ vét công quỹ
words.definition_en: A society whose leaders make themselves rich and powerful by stealing.
examples: Investigative journalists exposed the offshore accounts of the kleptocracy.

words.definition_vi: Người vận động hành lang chính sách
words.definition_en: A person who takes part in an organized attempt to influence legislators.
examples: Renewable energy lobbyists advocated for solar tax credits.

words.definition_vi: Tuyên ngôn chính trị / Cương lĩnh tranh cử
words.definition_en: A public declaration of policy and aims, especially one issued before an election.
examples: The party launched its election manifesto promising healthcare reform.

words.definition_vi: Chính sách không liên kết quân sự
words.definition_en: National foreign policy of neutrality toward major power blocs.
examples: The Non-Aligned Movement united developing nations during the Cold War.

words.definition_vi: Thanh tra nhân dân độc lập tiếp nhận khiếu nại
words.definition_en: An official appointed to investigate individuals' complaints against administration.
examples: Citizens filed a petition with the parliamentary ombudsman.

words.definition_vi: Chính thể giới siêu giàu tài phiệt cầm quyền
words.definition_en: Government by the wealthy.
examples: Critics warned that uncontrolled campaign donations turn democracy into a plutocracy.

words.definition_vi: Điểm danh xác định đủ số lượng đại biểu quốc hội
words.definition_en: A procedure to determine whether a quorum is present in legislative session.
examples: The senate leader ordered a quorum-call before opening debate.

words.definition_vi: Sự phê chuẩn chính thức hiệp ước
words.definition_en: The action of signing or giving formal consent to a treaty.
examples: Parliament voted for the immediate ratification of the climate accord.

words.definition_vi: Tài năng lãnh đạo quản quốc kiệt xuất
words.definition_en: Skill in managing public affairs; wisdom and integrity in political leadership.
examples: Her diplomatic statesmanship prevented a devastating regional war.

words.definition_vi: Độc tài toàn trị kiểm soát toàn bộ xã hội
words.definition_en: Relating to a system of government that is centralized and dictatorial.
examples: George Orwell's novel '1984' depicts a terrifying totalitarian state.

words.definition_vi: Quyền phổ thông đầu phiếu (Mọi công dân đều được bầu cử)
words.definition_en: The right of almost all adult citizens to vote in political elections.
examples: The constitution established universal suffrage regardless of gender or wealth.

words.definition_vi: Tỷ lệ cử tri đi bầu cử
words.definition_en: The percentage of eligible voters who cast a ballot in an election.
examples: Civic education campaigns boosted youth voter turnout to 78%.

words.definition_vi: Chính thể do người ngoại quốc cai trị
words.definition_en: Government by foreigners or an outside foreign power.
examples: Colonial administration was a historic example of imposed xenocracy.

words.definition_vi: Chính trị đáp ứng trào lưu thời đại
words.definition_en: Political movements reflecting the prevailing spirit and consciousness of the era.
examples: Grassroots digital activism embodies modern zeitgeist-politics.

description: Khoa học vũ trụ, thiên văn học và khám phá dải ngân hà

words.definition_vi: Tiểu hành tinh
words.definition_en: A small rocky body orbiting the sun, especially in asteroid belt.
examples: NASA sent a robotic probe to collect samples from an asteroid.

words.definition_vi: Hố đen vũ trụ
words.definition_en: A region of space having a gravitational field so intense that no matter can escape.
examples: The supermassive black hole sits at the center of the Milky Way galaxy.

words.definition_vi: Chòm sao
words.definition_en: A group of stars forming a recognizable pattern that is traditionally named.
examples: Orion is one of the most easily identifiable constellations in night sky.

words.definition_vi: Vật chất tối
words.definition_en: Unseen non-baryonic material that accounts for approximately 85% of matter in universe.
examples: Astrophysicists study gravitational lensing to map invisible dark matter.

words.definition_vi: Hiện tượng nhật thực / nguyệt thực
words.definition_en: An obscuring of the light from one celestial body by the passage of another.
examples: Thousands of spectators wore protective glasses to watch the solar eclipse.

words.definition_vi: Phản ứng nhiệt hạch hạt nhân
words.definition_en: Nuclear reaction in which atomic nuclei fuse to form heavier nucleus.
examples: Nuclear fusion inside the sun produces virtually limitless energy.

words.definition_vi: Thiên hà, dải ngân hà
words.definition_en: A system of millions or billions of stars, together with gas and dust.
examples: The Andromeda galaxy is the closest major spiral galaxy to our own.

words.definition_vi: Trạm trung chuyển không gian / Trung tâm kết nối
words.definition_en: The central part of a wheel or system of connecting elements.
examples: The International Space Station serves as a research hub.

words.definition_vi: Xuyên giữa các vì sao
words.definition_en: Occurring or situated between stars.
examples: The Voyager 1 probe is humanity's first spacecraft in interstellar space.

words.definition_vi: Sao Mộc (Hành tinh lớn nhất)
words.definition_en: The largest planet in the solar system, a gas giant with rings and moons.
examples: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a colossal storm larger than Earth.

words.definition_vi: Thuộc về động năng
words.definition_en: Relating to or resulting from motion.
examples: An accelerating rocket possesses massive kinetic energy.

words.definition_vi: Năm ánh sáng (Đơn vị khoảng cách vũ trụ)
words.definition_en: A unit of astronomical distance equivalent to distance light travels in one year.
examples: Proxima Centauri is approximately 4.2 light-years away from Earth.

words.definition_vi: Tinh vân vũ trụ (Đám mây bụi sao)
words.definition_en: A cloud of gas and dust in outer space, visible in the night sky.
examples: The Orion Nebula is a vibrant stellar nursery where new stars form.

words.definition_vi: Quỹ đạo chuyển động quanh hành tinh
words.definition_en: The curved path of a celestial object or spacecraft around a star or planet.
examples: The weather satellite completes one Earth orbit every 90 minutes.

words.definition_vi: Sao xung phát xung vô tuyến
words.definition_en: A celestial object, thought to be a rapidly rotating neutron star, emitting pulses.
examples: Radio telescopes detected rhythmic electromagnetic pulses from a distant pulsar.

words.definition_vi: Lượng tử học
words.definition_en: The minimum amount of any physical entity involved in an interaction.
examples: Quantum mechanics describes atomic behavior that defies classical physics.

words.definition_vi: Xe tự hành thám hiểm sao Hỏa
words.definition_en: A vehicle for exploring the surface of an extraterrestrial body.
examples: NASA's Perseverance rover searches for ancient microbial life on Mars.

words.definition_vi: Vụ nổ siêu tân tinh
words.definition_en: A star that suddenly increases greatly in brightness because of explosion.
examples: A dying giant star exploded into a brilliant supernova.

words.definition_vi: Kính thiên văn quan sát vũ trụ
words.definition_en: An optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer.
examples: The James Webb Space Telescope captures infrared images of deep space.

words.definition_vi: Vũ trụ bao la
words.definition_en: All existing matter and space considered as a whole; the cosmos.
examples: The observable universe contains an estimated two trillion galaxies.

words.definition_vi: Chân không trong không gian
words.definition_en: A space entirely devoid of matter.
examples: Outer space is a near-perfect vacuum with zero atmospheric pressure.

words.definition_vi: Bước sóng ánh sáng / bức xạ
words.definition_en: The distance between successive crests of a wave, especially in radiation.
examples: Infrared telescopes observe wavelengths invisible to the human eye.

words.definition_vi: Thiên văn học tia X
words.definition_en: An observational branch of astronomy dealing with X-ray emission from objects.
examples: X-ray astronomy reveals high-energy phenomena around black holes.

words.definition_vi: Khối lượng vật chất tạo thành sau phản ứng sao
words.definition_en: The total mass of synthesized elements from stellar nucleosynthesis.
examples: Supernovae explosions yield-mass of heavy elements like gold and uranium.

words.definition_vi: Hiện tượng thiên thể đi qua thiên đỉnh
words.definition_en: The moment a celestial body crosses the observer's local meridian.
examples: Astronomers timed the star's precise zenith-transit across the night sky.

words.definition_vi: Điểm viễn địa (Điểm xa Trái Đất nhất của quỹ đạo)
words.definition_en: The point in the orbit of the moon or a satellite at which it is furthest from Earth.
examples: The communications satellite reached its apogee of 36,000 kilometers.

words.definition_vi: Hạt baryon (Proton, Neutron cấu tạo vật chất)
words.definition_en: A subatomic particle, such as a nucleon or hyperon, composed of three quarks.
examples: Normal atomic matter is composed of protons, neutrons, and baryons.

words.definition_vi: Thuộc về bầu trời / Thiên thể vũ trụ
words.definition_en: Positioned in or relating to the sky, or outer space as observed in astronomy.
examples: Comets and meteors are fascinating celestial phenomena.

words.definition_vi: Hiệu ứng Đốp-le chuyển dịch tần số sóng
words.definition_en: An increase/decrease in the frequency of sound, light, or other waves as source moves.
examples: The Doppler effect causes redshift in light from receding distant galaxies.

words.definition_vi: Hành tinh ngoài hệ mặt trời
words.definition_en: A planet of a star other than the sun.
examples: Astronomers have discovered thousands of rocky exoplanets in habitable zones.

words.definition_vi: Vụ bùng phát bão lửa mặt trời
words.definition_en: A sudden brief burst of bright flame or light, or solar eruption.
examples: A massive solar flare disrupted radio communications on Earth.

words.definition_vi: Lực hấp dẫn vũ trụ
words.definition_en: Movement, or a tendency to move, toward a center of gravity.
examples: Universal gravitation keeps planets in stable orbits around stars.

words.definition_vi: Nhật quyển bảo vệ hệ mặt trời
words.definition_en: The region of space surrounding the sun inflated by the solar wind.
examples: The heliosphere shields our solar system from harmful cosmic rays.

words.definition_vi: Tầng điện ly khí quyển
words.definition_en: The layer of the Earth's atmosphere that contains a high concentration of ions.
examples: Shortwave radio signals bounce off the ionosphere for global transmission.

words.definition_vi: Dòng tia gió quyển tầng cao
words.definition_en: A narrow, variable band of very strong, predominantly westerly air currents.
examples: Commercial airliners utilize high-altitude jet streams to save jet fuel.

words.definition_vi: Vành đai Kuiper ngoài sao Hải Vương
words.definition_en: A region of the solar system beyond the orbit of Neptune, containing icy bodies.
examples: Pluto resides within the icy debris of the Kuiper belt.

words.definition_vi: Độ sáng tuyệt đối của thiên thể
words.definition_en: The total amount of energy emitted by a star, galaxy, or other celestial object.
examples: Giant blue stars possess thousands of times the luminosity of the sun.

words.definition_vi: Từ quyển Trái Đất
words.definition_en: The region surrounding the earth in which its magnetic field is the predominant field.
examples: Earth's magnetosphere deflects dangerous high-energy solar winds.

words.definition_vi: Sao neutron siêu đặc
words.definition_en: A celestial object of very small radius and very high density, composed of neutrons.
examples: A teaspoon of neutron star matter would weigh billions of tons on Earth.

words.definition_vi: Đài thiên văn ngắm sao
words.definition_en: A room or building housing an astronomical telescope.
examples: The mountaintop observatory provides crystal-clear views of outer space.

words.definition_vi: Thị sai đo khoảng cách sao
words.definition_en: The effect whereby the position or direction of an object appears to differ when viewed.
examples: Astronomers use stellar parallax to calculate the distances to nearby stars.

words.definition_vi: Luồng tia plasma bắn ra từ chuẩn tinh
words.definition_en: A relativistic beam of ionized matter emitted from a supermassive black hole.
examples: Radio observatories imaged plasma quasar-jets extending across galaxies.

words.definition_vi: Hiện tượng dịch chuyển đỏ (Vũ trụ giãn nở)
words.definition_en: A shift toward longer wavelengths of the spectral lines emitted by a celestial object.
examples: Galactic redshift provided definitive proof that the universe is expanding.

words.definition_vi: Quang phổ học phân tích thành phần sao
words.definition_en: The branch of science concerned with the investigation and measurement of spectra.
examples: Spectroscopy allows astronomers to detect water vapor on distant exoplanets.

words.definition_vi: Nhiệt hạch hạt nhân
words.definition_en: Relating to or using nuclear reactions that occur only at very high temperatures.
examples: Thermonuclear fusion powers the radiant heat and light of our sun.

words.definition_vi: Vùng bóng tối hoàn toàn (Nhật thực)
words.definition_en: The fully shaded inner region of a shadow cast by an opaque object.
examples: Observers within the path of the Moon's umbra witnessed a total solar eclipse.

words.definition_vi: Sao biến quang thay đổi độ sáng
words.definition_en: A star whose brightness as seen from Earth changes with time.
examples: Cepheid variable stars act as cosmic distance markers across space.

words.definition_vi: Lỗ sâu không-thời gian (Cầu nối Einstein-Rosen)
words.definition_en: A hypothetical connection between widely separated regions of space-time.
examples: Theoretical physicists study whether wormholes could permit interstellar shortcuts.

words.definition_vi: Động cơ đẩy ion bằng khí Xenon cho tàu vũ trụ
words.definition_en: Ion thruster technology utilizing ionized noble gas for propulsion.
examples: Deep space probes use fuel-efficient xenon-propulsion engines.

words.definition_vi: Ánh sáng hoàng đạo trong đêm
words.definition_en: A faint, roughly triangular glow in the night sky produced by sunlight scattering.
examples: Campers in remote desert valleys observed the faint zodiacal light before dawn.

description: Kiến trúc công trình, thị trường nhà ở và bất động sản

words.definition_vi: Tiện ích tòa nhà / khu dân cư
words.definition_en: A desirable or useful feature or facility of a building or place.
examples: The luxury apartment complex offers swimming pool and gym amenities.

words.definition_vi: Bản vẽ thiết kế kiến trúc
words.definition_en: A design plan or other technical drawing.
examples: The architect presented detailed architectural blueprints for the villa.

words.definition_vi: Căn hộ chung cư cao cấp (Condo)
words.definition_en: A building or complex of buildings containing a number of individually owned apartments.
examples: They purchased a modern two-bedroom condominium downtown.

words.definition_vi: Sự phá dỡ công trình cũ
words.definition_en: The action or process of demolishing or being demolished.
examples: The old factory underwent safe structural demolition.

words.definition_vi: Thang máy
words.definition_en: A platform or compartment housed in a shaft for raising and lowering people.
examples: Take the express elevator up to the 45th-floor observation deck.

words.definition_vi: Mặt tiền kiến trúc công trình
words.definition_en: The principal front of a building, that faces on to a street or open space.
examples: The historic theater features a restored neoclassical marble facade.

words.definition_vi: Máng xối thoát nước mưa trên mái nhà
words.definition_en: A shallow trough fixed beneath the edge of a roof for carrying off rainwater.
examples: Clean autumn leaves out of the roof gutters to prevent leaks.

words.definition_vi: Tòa nhà chọc trời cao tầng
words.definition_en: A building that has many stories.
examples: High-rise towers dominate the modern city center skyline.

words.definition_vi: Vật liệu cách âm / cách nhiệt
words.definition_en: The state of being insulated; material used to insulate something.
examples: Double-glazed windows provide excellent thermal and acoustic insulation.

words.definition_vi: Dầm đỡ sàn / trần nhà
words.definition_en: A length of timber or steel supporting the structure of a floor or ceiling.
examples: Carpenters installed heavy steel joists to reinforce the second floor.

words.definition_vi: Gian bếp nhỏ gọn tiện lợi
words.definition_en: A small kitchen or part of a room equipped as a kitchen.
examples: Studio apartments usually include a compact kitchenette.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nhà cho thuê
words.definition_en: A person who rents land, a building, or an apartment to a tenant.
examples: The landlord agreed to repair the leaking bathroom pipes.

words.definition_vi: Công trình xây dựng bằng gạch đá
words.definition_en: Stonework or brickwork.
examples: The gothic cathedral's exquisite stone masonry has survived for centuries.

words.definition_vi: Khu dân cư, khu xóm lân cận
words.definition_en: A district, especially one forming a community within a town or city.
examples: They live in a quiet, tree-lined residential neighborhood.

words.definition_vi: Tỷ lệ lấp đầy phòng / Tình trạng cư ngụ
words.definition_en: The action of occupying a place; the proportion of accommodation used.
examples: The newly opened luxury apartment achieved 95% occupancy.

words.definition_vi: Căn hộ áp mái cao cấp nhất
words.definition_en: An apartment on the top floor of a tall building.
examples: The billionaire purchased a panoramic rooftop penthouse.

words.definition_vi: Gạch đá xây ốp góc tường kiến trúc
words.definition_en: An external angle of a wall or building; cornerstone.
examples: The brick mansion featured decorative limestone quoins on each corner.

words.definition_vi: Sự sửa chữa nâng cấp nhà cửa
words.definition_en: The action of renovating a building or structure.
examples: The historic brownstone underwent a multi-million dollar renovation.

words.definition_vi: Khu ngoại ô yên tĩnh
words.definition_en: An outlying district of a city, especially a residential one.
examples: Many young families choose to live in green peaceful suburbs.

words.definition_vi: Người thuê nhà / căn hộ
words.definition_en: A person who occupies land or property rented from a landlord.
examples: The new tenant signed a twelve-month residential lease agreement.

words.definition_vi: Dịch vụ điện, nước, internet cơ bản
words.definition_en: An organization supplying a community with electricity, gas, water.
examples: Monthly apartment rent includes water, gas, and electricity utilities.

words.definition_vi: Hệ thống thông gió làm thoáng khí
words.definition_en: The provision of fresh air to a room or building.
examples: Proper ventilation prevents mold growth in bathrooms and basements.

words.definition_vi: Thi công chống thấm dột
words.definition_en: Making something impervious to water.
examples: Roof waterproofing prevents water damage during monsoon rains.

words.definition_vi: Hệ thống chiếu sáng đèn Xenon kiến trúc
words.definition_en: High-intensity discharge lighting used for building facades.
examples: Architects specified xenon-lighting to illuminate the museum exterior.

words.definition_vi: Sân vườn trước/sau nhà
words.definition_en: A piece of ground adjoining a building or house.
examples: Children played soccer in the fenced backyard.

words.definition_vi: Quy hoạch phân khu đô thị
words.definition_en: The dividing of an area by local authorities into zones for specific uses.
examples: Municipal zoning laws prohibit commercial nightclubs in residential areas.

words.definition_vi: Nơi cư trú, chốn dung thân
words.definition_en: A place of residence; a house or home.
examples: The cozy country cottage was his humble humble abode.

words.definition_vi: Lan can con tiện chạm khắc
words.definition_en: A railing supported by balusters, especially on a balcony.
examples: The grand marble staircase was flanked by an ornate balustrade.

words.definition_vi: Dầm công-xôn nhô ra ngoài không cột đỡ
words.definition_en: A long projecting beam or girder fixed at only one end.
examples: The architect designed a dramatic cantilevered rooftop balcony.

words.definition_vi: Cửa sổ mái nhô ra từ mái dốc
words.definition_en: A window that projects vertically from a sloping roof.
examples: The attic bedroom is illuminated by sunlight from two dormer windows.

words.definition_vi: Quyền sử dụng lối đi qua đất người khác
words.definition_en: A right to cross or otherwise use someone else's land for a specified purpose.
examples: The property deed grants an easement for municipal utility power lines.

words.definition_vi: Nghệ thuật sắp đặt cửa sổ kiến trúc
words.definition_en: The arrangement of windows and doors on the elevations of a building.
examples: The glass skyscraper features rhythmically aligned modern fenestration.

words.definition_vi: Đầu hồi mái nhà hình tam giác
words.definition_en: The triangular part of an outside wall formed by the sides of a sloping roof.
examples: The charming Dutch townhouse had an ornamental brick gable.

words.definition_vi: Đủ điều kiện an toàn để sinh sống
words.definition_en: Suitable or good enough to live in.
examples: Inspectors declared the renovated historic house fully habitable.

words.definition_vi: Cơ sở hạ tầng đô thị
words.definition_en: The basic physical and organizational structures needed for operation.
examples: Investment in subway infrastructure boosted suburban real estate prices.

words.definition_vi: Khóa vòm đá đỉnh vòm cầu
words.definition_en: A central stone at the summit of an arch, locking the whole together.
examples: Masons placed the final carved keystone at the arch's apex.

words.definition_vi: Lanh-tô ngang đỡ cửa đi/cửa sổ
words.definition_en: A horizontal support of timber or stone across the top of a door or window.
examples: A heavy oak lintel supports the weight above the fireplace.

words.definition_vi: Tầng lửng, gác xép lửng
words.definition_en: A low story between two others in a building, typically between ground and first floors.
examples: The coffee shop features cozy seating on the upper mezzanine.

words.definition_vi: Góc nhỏ ấm cúng trong nhà
words.definition_en: A corner or recess, especially one offering seclusion or security.
examples: She created a peaceful reading nook beside the bay window.

words.definition_vi: Mái hiên đua nhô ra che nắng mưa
words.definition_en: A part of a roof or structure that hangs over something below.
examples: Deep roof overhangs protect the timber walls from direct sunlight.

words.definition_vi: Tường bao lan can sân thượng
words.definition_en: A low protective wall along the edge of a roof, bridge, or balcony.

examples: Customs officers inspected the container ship's cargo manifest.

words.definition_vi: Điểm trung chuyển trong mạng lưới kho
words.definition_en: A connecting point or redistribution center in a transport network.
examples: The airport serves as a primary logistics node for transshipment.

words.definition_vi: Quy trình hoàn tất và giao đơn hàng
words.definition_en: The complete process from point of sales inquiry to delivery to buyer.
examples: Automated warehouses achieve same-day order fulfillment.

words.definition_vi: Tấm kê hàng pallet bằng gỗ/nhựa
words.definition_en: A flat wooden or plastic structure on which goods are stacked for transport.
examples: Forklift drivers loaded 40 wooden pallets onto the flatbed truck.

words.definition_vi: Hạn ngạch nhập khẩu
words.definition_en: A limited quantity of a particular product which under official controls can be imported.
examples: The trade ministry set an annual import quota on raw cotton.

words.definition_vi: Định tuyến đường đi giao hàng tối ưu
words.definition_en: The process of selecting paths in a network for freight travel.
examples: GPS route optimization software calculates the fastest delivery routing.

words.definition_vi: Chuỗi cung ứng toàn cầu
words.definition_en: The sequence of processes involved in the production and distribution of a commodity.
examples: Global supply chain disruptions caused computer chip shortages.

words.definition_vi: Theo dõi hành trình bưu phẩm trực tuyến
words.definition_en: The activity of observing and recording the path of a shipment.
examples: Customers receive a real-time parcel tracking code via SMS.

words.definition_vi: Hoạt động bốc dỡ hàng xuống
words.definition_en: The action of removing goods from a vehicle, ship, or aircraft.
examples: Dockworkers supervised the container unloading at the harbor quay.

words.definition_vi: Nhà cung cấp đối tác
words.definition_en: A person or company offering goods or services for sale.
examples: We negotiate bulk discounts directly with manufacturing vendors.

words.definition_vi: Kho chứa hàng hóa
words.definition_en: A large building where raw materials or manufactured goods may be stored.
examples: Amazon operates high-tech automated fulfillment warehouses.

words.definition_vi: Công nghệ quét mã vạch đèn Xenon tốc độ cao
words.definition_en: High-speed optical scanning technology used in parcel sorting.
examples: Automated conveyor belts utilize xenon-barcode readers.

words.definition_vi: Năng lực thông qua hàng hóa của cảng
words.definition_en: The total volume of goods processed through a terminal per hour.
examples: Modern gantry cranes doubled the port's container yield-throughput.

words.definition_vi: Tiêu chuẩn không lỗi sản phẩm
words.definition_en: Having no defects or errors; conforming strictly to quality specs.
examples: Quality assurance teams enforce zero-defect manufacturing.

words.definition_vi: Dây chuyền lắp ráp công nghiệp
words.definition_en: A series of workers and machines in a factory by which items are assembled.
examples: Robots weld automotive chassis along the high-speed assembly line.

words.definition_vi: Vận đơn đường biển (B/L)
words.definition_en: A detailed list of a shipment of cargo in the form of a receipt.
examples: The bank released payment upon receiving the original bill of lading.

words.definition_vi: Lô hàng gửi ủy thác
words.definition_en: A batch of goods destined for or delivered to someone.
examples: The customs officer cleared a large consignment of pharmaceuticals.

words.definition_vi: Phí lưu container / lưu bãi quá hạn
words.definition_en: A charge payable to the owner of a chartered ship on failure to load/unload in time.
examples: The importer paid demurrage fees because containers stayed at port too long.

words.definition_vi: Đẩy nhanh tiến độ giao hàng
words.definition_en: Make an action or process happen sooner or be accomplished more quickly.
examples: Please expedite the overseas shipment to meet the holiday rush.

words.definition_vi: Hoàn tất xử lý đơn hàng
words.definition_en: The process of fulfilling an order, including packaging and shipping.
examples: The company outsourced ecommerce fulfillment to specialized centers.

words.definition_vi: Tổng trọng lượng cả hàng và bao bì
words.definition_en: The total weight of goods including the packaging or vehicle.
examples: The truck's gross weight exceeded the maximum highway bridge limit.

words.definition_vi: Kéo chở hàng đường dài
words.definition_en: Transport something in a truck or other vehicle.
examples: Long-distance truckers haul agricultural produce across the country.

words.definition_vi: Vận tải đa phương thức kết hợp (Tàu hỏa + Xe tải + Tàu biển)
words.definition_en: Relating to or involving two or more different modes of transport in conveying goods.
examples: Intermodal container shipping eliminates unloading and reloading at ports.

words.definition_vi: Cầu cảng bốc dỡ hàng hóa
words.definition_en: A landing stage or small pier at which boats can dock or be moored.
examples: Fuel barges docked alongside the specialized industrial jetty.

words.definition_vi: Hàng linh kiện tháo rời (CKD/SKD)
words.definition_en: Goods supplied in parts ready for assembly.
examples: Automakers ship complete knockdown vehicle kits for local assembly.

words.definition_vi: Chặng giao hàng cuối cùng đến tay khách
words.definition_en: Relating to the final stage of the delivery process to customer's doorstep.
examples: Electric delivery vans solve urban last-mile delivery challenges.

words.definition_vi: Sổ đăng ký đăng kiểm tàu thuyền vận tải
words.definition_en: An official register of vessels and cargo transport equipment.
examples: The cargo vessel is registered in the international maritime matricula.

words.definition_vi: Trọng lượng tịnh của hàng hóa
words.definition_en: The weight of the goods alone, not including packaging.
examples: The net weight of the olive oil shipment is 500 kilograms.

words.definition_vi: Thuê ngoài dịch vụ kho vận
words.definition_en: Obtain goods or services from an outside supplier.
examples: Small ecommerce shops outsource warehouse packaging to 3PL partners.

words.definition_vi: Hàng hóa dễ ôi thiu hỏng hóc (Thực phẩm tươi sống)
words.definition_en: Likely to decay or go bad quickly.
examples: Refrigerated container trucks transport perishable fresh seafood.

words.definition_vi: Điều phối xe bốc xếp tại cửa kho
words.definition_en: Systematic coordination of transport vehicles arriving at loading docks.
examples: Digital queue-management eliminates truck congestion outside distribution hubs.

words.definition_vi: Logistics thu hồi hàng trả lại / tái chế
words.definition_en: The process of moving goods from their typical final destination for purpose of capturing value or disposal.
examples: Ecommerce retailers need efficient reverse logistics to handle customer returns.

words.definition_vi: Tổn thất hàng tồn do hư hỏng / mất cắp
words.definition_en: The loss of inventory that can be attributed to factors such as employee theft, damage.
examples: Security cameras and audits help retail stores minimize inventory shrinkage.

words.definition_vi: Thuế quan xuất nhập khẩu
words.definition_en: A tax or duty to be paid on a particular class of imports or exports.
examples: The government imposed a 10% customs tariff on imported electronics.

words.definition_vi: Giao hàng không cần người nhận trực tiếp (Để trước cửa/hòm thư)
words.definition_en: Delivery of packages to secure doorstep lockers without face-to-face handoff.
examples: Smart parcel lockers facilitate secure unattended-delivery.

words.definition_vi: Tàu thủy chở hàng cỡ lớn
words.definition_en: A ship or large boat.
examples: The ocean container vessel can carry 24,000 TEU containers.

words.definition_vi: Vận đơn gửi kèm hàng hóa
words.definition_en: A document issued by a carrier giving details and instructions relating to shipment.
examples: The courier scanned the international air waybill barcode.

words.definition_vi: Tính cước vận chuyển theo khu vực
words.definition_en: Pricing strategy where shipping rates vary based on geographical delivery zone.
examples: Logistics providers apply zone-pricing for cross-country parcel delivery.

description: Dịch vụ khách hàng, quản trị khách sạn và du lịch lưu trú

words.definition_vi: Tiện ích phòng khách sạn
words.definition_en: A desirable or useful feature or facility of a building or room.
examples: Hotel room amenities include plush bathrobes, a mini-bar, and free Wi-Fi.

words.definition_vi: Nhân viên xách hành lý khách sạn
words.definition_en: A person who helps guests with their luggage in a hotel.
examples: The courteous bellhop carried our heavy suitcases to the suite.

words.definition_vi: Nhân viên hỗ trợ thông tin và đặt chỗ
words.definition_en: A hotel employee whose job is to assist guests by booking tours, making reservations.
examples: The concierge booked us front-row theater tickets and arranged a taxi.

words.definition_vi: Nhân viên gác cửa khách sạn
words.definition_en: A person whose job is to stand at the door of a hotel, welcoming guests.
examples: The smiling doorman hailed a yellow cab in the pouring rain.

words.definition_vi: Phòng có nhà vệ sinh khép kín bên trong
words.definition_en: Denoting a bathroom that is directly connected to a bedroom.
examples: The master bedroom features an ensuite marble bathroom with jacuzzi.

words.definition_vi: Quầy lễ tân khách sạn
words.definition_en: The desk in a hotel where guests check in and out.
examples: Please leave your room key at the front desk when going out.

words.definition_vi: Tiền boa / tiền tip cảm ơn
words.definition_en: A tip given to a server or hotel staff for service.
examples: A 15% gratuity is customary for exceptional restaurant table service.

words.definition_vi: Bộ phận buồng phòng dọn dẹp
words.definition_en: The department responsible for cleaning and maintenance in a hotel.
examples: Housekeeping provided fresh towels and replenished the shampoo.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nhà trọ, chủ quán trọ
words.definition_en: A person who owns or manages an inn or guesthouse.
examples: The friendly innkeeper served homemade scones and hot tea.

words.definition_vi: Bồn tắm nước nóng sục khí Jacuzzi
words.definition_en: A large bath with a system of underwater jets of water to massage body.
examples: Relaxing in the outdoor heated jacuzzi soothed our sore muscles.

words.definition_vi: Thẻ từ mở khóa phòng
words.definition_en: A plastic card with a magnetic strip or RFID chip used as a key.
examples: Tap your electronic keycard against the reader to unlock the door.

words.definition_vi: Ga trải giường, khăn vải khách sạn
words.definition_en: Sheets, duvet covers, and pillowcases used on beds.
examples: Crisp white Egyptian cotton linens guarantee a restful sleep.

words.definition_vi: Tủ lạnh nhỏ chứa đồ uống trong phòng
words.definition_en: A small refrigerator in a hotel room, containing beverages and snacks.
examples: Bottled mineral water from the room minibar is complimentary.

words.definition_vi: Kiểm toán viên ca đêm của khách sạn
words.definition_en: A hotel employee who handles late check-ins and balances financial daybooks.
examples: The night auditor checked the guest in at 3 AM and printed the bill.

words.definition_vi: Nghỉ qua đêm
words.definition_en: For or during the night.
examples: We booked an overnight stay near the airport before our early flight.

words.definition_vi: Nhân viên khuân vác hành lý
words.definition_en: A person employed to carry luggage and other loads, especially in a hotel.
examples: The hotel porter loaded our golf bags into the airport shuttle.

words.definition_vi: Phòng 4 giường / cho 4 người
words.definition_en: A hotel room configured to accommodate four guests comfortably.
examples: Families traveling with children often reserve a spacious quad-room.

words.definition_vi: Nhân viên lễ tân tiếp đón
words.definition_en: A person employed in an office or hotel to greet visitors and answer calls.
examples: The polite receptionist handed us a map of the historic center.

words.definition_vi: Phòng Suite thượng hạng (Có phòng khách riêng)
words.definition_en: A set of connected rooms, especially in a hotel, forming a pleasant unit.
examples: The bridal couple stayed in the panoramic ocean-view presidential suite.

words.definition_vi: Dịch vụ chuẩn bị giường ngủ buổi tối
words.definition_en: A hotel service where the bed is prepared for sleeping and chocolates are left.
examples: Luxury hotels provide evening turn-down service with lavender pillow mist.

words.definition_vi: Nâng cấp hạng phòng khách sạn
words.definition_en: Raise to a higher standard, particular in category of hotel room.
examples: The front desk upgraded our standard room to a deluxe ocean suite for free.

words.definition_vi: Nhân viên đỗ xe hộ / Giặt ủi riêng
words.definition_en: A person employed to park cars or look after passengers' personal clothes.
examples: Hand your car keys to the hotel valet upon arrival at the driveway.

words.definition_vi: Cuộc gọi báo thức của khách sạn
words.definition_en: A telephone call made by hotel staff to wake a sleeping guest at a set time.
examples: I requested a 5:30 AM wake-up call so I wouldn't miss my flight.

words.definition_vi: Nhà khách lưu trú từ thiện thời cổ
words.definition_en: A room or building for the reception of strangers and pilgrims.
examples: Historians visited the preserved medieval monastic xenodochium.

words.definition_vi: Doanh thu trên công suất phòng (RevPAR)
words.definition_en: The revenue generated per available room in revenue management.
examples: Dynamic room pricing maximized hotel yield-occupancy during the festival.

words.definition_vi: Khu spa thư giãn thiền định
words.definition_en: A tranquility spa facility offering massages, hydrotherapy, and meditation.
examples: Guests unwind with herbal aromatherapy massages at the hotel zen-spa.

words.definition_vi: Gói nghỉ dưỡng trọn gói (Ăn, uống, ở)
words.definition_en: Including all the services or items normally charged for separately.
examples: The seaside Caribbean resort offers all-inclusive dining, drinks, and watersports.

words.definition_vi: Tiệc chiêu đãi lớn tại khách sạn
words.definition_en: An elaborate and formal evening meal for many people, with speeches.
examples: The grand hotel ballroom hosted an annual corporate awards banquet.

words.definition_vi: Miễn phí đãi ngộ cho khách
words.definition_en: Given or supplied free of charge.
examples: Guests receive complimentary breakfast and a welcome fruit basket.

words.definition_vi: Hạng sang cao cấp
words.definition_en: Luxurious or of particularly high quality.
examples: We booked a deluxe sea-facing room with a private balcony.

words.definition_vi: Nhận phòng sớm trước giờ quy định
words.definition_en: Checking into a hotel room before the standard check-in hour.
examples: The hotel accommodated our early check-in at 10 AM without extra charge.

words.definition_vi: Gói ăn 3 bữa tại khách sạn (Sáng, Trưa, Tối)
words.definition_en: Provision of all meals (breakfast, lunch, and dinner) in hotel rate.
examples: We opted for full board so we wouldn't have to search for restaurants.

words.definition_vi: Bộ phận chăm sóc trải nghiệm khách hàng
words.definition_en: The department that handles VIP requests and resolves complaints.
examples: The guest relations manager sent champagne to celebrate our anniversary.

words.definition_vi: Gói ăn 2 bữa (Sáng + Tối)
words.definition_en: Provision of bed, breakfast, and one main meal per day at a hotel.
examples: Half board is ideal if you plan to explore cities during lunch hours.

words.definition_vi: Phòng y tế sơ cấp cứu khách sạn
words.definition_en: A place in a large institution for the care of those who are ill.
examples: The resort infirmary provided first-aid treatment for the minor sunburn.

words.definition_vi: Đặt phòng liên thông / Đặt theo nhóm
words.definition_en: A reservation made simultaneously for connected rooms or groups.
examples: The tour operator organized a joint-booking for twenty tour members.

words.definition_vi: Giường cỡ lớn King Size (1m8 - 2m)
words.definition_en: Larger than standard or queen size.
examples: The master suite features a plush king-size bed with down pillows.

words.definition_vi: Trả phòng muộn sau giờ quy định
words.definition_en: Leaving a hotel room after the standard check-out time (e.g. 2 PM).
examples: Loyalty club members enjoy guaranteed 4 PM late check-out privileges.

words.definition_vi: Quản lý nhà hàng sang trọng / Trưởng bàn
words.definition_en: The head waiter of a restaurant who welcomes guests and supervises staff.
examples: The distinguished maître d' escorted us to our reserved private booth.

words.definition_vi: Phòng không hút thuốc lá
words.definition_en: Designating an area or building in which smoking is prohibited.
examples: All guest rooms in the luxury hotel are strictly non-smoking.

words.definition_vi: Giới hạn số người ở tối đa trong phòng
words.definition_en: The maximum number of guests legally permitted in a room.
examples: Fire safety codes establish a strict four-person occupancy limit.

words.definition_vi: Sân hiên ngoài trời lát đá
words.definition_en: A paved outdoor area adjoining a house or hotel room.
examples: We enjoyed cocktails on the sunny garden patio overlooking the pool.

words.definition_vi: Quy định giờ yên tĩnh ban đêm
words.definition_en: Designated nighttime hours when noise must be kept to a minimum.
examples: Hotel quiet hours are strictly enforced between 10 PM and 7 AM.

words.definition_vi: Dịch vụ phục vụ đồ ăn tại phòng
words.definition_en: A service provided in a hotel allowing guests to order food/drinks to rooms.
examples: We ordered midnight pasta and ice cream from 24-hour room service.

words.definition_vi: Ghế sofa kéo thành giường ngủ
words.definition_en: A sofa with a seat that folds out to form a bed.
examples: The living area includes a comfortable pull-out sofa-bed for kids.

words.definition_vi: Bảng giá phòng và dịch vụ niêm yết
words.definition_en: A table of charges at a hotel, restaurant, or for public service.
examples: Check the seasonal room tariff published on the resort website.

words.definition_vi: Chưa có người đặt trước
words.definition_en: Not kept back for a particular person; open for booking.
examples: There were several unreserved poolside cabanas available this morning.

words.definition_vi: Dịch vụ đỗ xe hộ
words.definition_en: A service in which someone parks your car for you at a hotel or venue.
examples: Complimentary valet parking is provided at the main hotel entrance.

words.definition_vi: Nồng hậu, hiếu khách, thân thiện
words.definition_en: Behaving in a friendly way to guests.
examples: The staff greeted us with a welcoming smile and chilled fruit juice.

words.definition_vi: Quầy bar trên tầng thượng cao nhất ngắm toàn cảnh
words.definition_en: A luxury rooftop sky lounge offering 360-degree city skyline views.
examples: Guests watched the fireworks display from the hotel's zenith-lounge.

description: Di sản văn hóa, phong tục tập quán và lễ hội truyền thống

words.definition_vi: Tổ tiên ông bà thời xưa
words.definition_en: A person, typically one more remote than a grandparent, from whom one is descended.
examples: During the Hungry Ghost festival, families honor their ancestors.

words.definition_vi: Lửa trại lễ hội ngoài trời
words.definition_en: A large open-air fire used for celebration, burning waste, or as a signal.
examples: Villagers danced around the giant midsummer festival bonfire.

words.definition_vi: Phong tục tập quán
words.definition_en: A traditional and widely accepted way of behaving or doing something.
examples: Giving red envelopes during Lunar New Year is a cherished custom.

words.definition_vi: Thần linh, vị thần tôn kính
words.definition_en: A god or goddess in a polytheistic religion.
examples: The temple is dedicated to the ancient protector deity of fishermen.

words.definition_vi: Bản sắc dân tộc / Sắc tộc
words.definition_en: The quality or fact of belonging to a population group with common national/cultural tradition.
examples: The carnival celebrates the city's rich diversity of ethnicities.

words.definition_vi: Văn hóa dân gian / Truyền thuyết dân gian
words.definition_en: The traditional beliefs, customs, and stories of a community passed by word of mouth.
examples: Vietnamese folklore is rich in dragon and fairy legends.

words.definition_vi: Vòng hoa đeo cổ chúc mừng lễ hội
words.definition_en: A wreath of flowers and leaves, worn on the head or hung as a decoration.
examples: Guests were welcomed with fragrant jasmine flower garlands.

words.definition_vi: Di sản văn hóa dân tộc
words.definition_en: Valued objects and qualities such as historic buildings and cultural traditions.
examples: Hoi An Ancient Town is recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site.

words.definition_vi: Bản địa truyền thống
words.definition_en: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
examples: The museum showcases intricate textiles of indigenous ethnic tribes.

words.definition_vi: Niềm vui sướng hân hoan lễ hội
words.definition_en: A feeling of great happiness and triumph.
examples: There was wild jubilation in the streets when the national soccer team won.

words.definition_vi: Tình thân tộc, mối liên kết huyết thống
words.definition_en: Sharing of characteristics or origins; blood relationship.
examples: Community festivals strengthen village solidarity and kinship bonds.

words.definition_vi: Đèn lồng lễ hội
words.definition_en: A lamp with a transparent case protecting the flame or electric bulb.
examples: Colorful silk lanterns illuminated the river during Mid-Autumn Festival.

words.definition_vi: Lễ hội hóa trang đeo mặt nạ
words.definition_en: A masked ball, festival, or false show and pretense.
examples: Venice is world-famous for its opulent annual carnival masquerade.

words.definition_vi: Quốc ca của đất nước
words.definition_en: A patriotic song officially adopted by a country as an expression of national identity.
examples: Athletes stood with hands on their hearts as the national anthem played.

words.definition_vi: Lễ vật dâng cúng tổ tiên / thần linh
words.definition_en: A thing offered, especially as a gift or contribution, or to a deity.
examples: Families place fresh fruit and incense on altars as an ancestral offering.

words.definition_vi: Đoàn rước lễ diễu hành trang trọng
words.definition_en: A number of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly fashion.
examples: A colorful dragon dance procession marched through the main avenue.

words.definition_vi: Cổ kính, độc đáo quyến rũ
words.definition_en: Attractively unusual or old-fashioned.
examples: The old quarter features quaint cobblestone lanes and wooden houses.

words.definition_vi: Nghi lễ truyền thống trang nghiêm
words.definition_en: A religious or solemn ceremony consisting of a series of actions performed.
examples: The tea ceremony is a refined Japanese Zen ritual.

words.definition_vi: Sự mê tín dị đoan
words.definition_en: Excessively credulous belief in and reverence for supernatural beings.
examples: Breaking a mirror is associated with seven years of bad luck in superstition.

words.definition_vi: Điều cấm kỵ văn hóa
words.definition_en: A social or religious custom prohibiting or restricting a particular practice.
examples: Touching someone's head is considered a cultural taboo in Thailand.

words.definition_vi: Khai quật di chỉ cổ vật
words.definition_en: Find something in the ground by digging.
examples: Archaeologists unearthed 2,000-year-old bronze drums in the valley.

words.definition_vi: Sự tôn kính, phụng thờ sùng bái
words.definition_en: Great respect; reverence.
examples: Ancestral veneration is a cornerstone of East Asian culture.

words.definition_vi: Tôn thờ, thờ cúng tôn giáo
words.definition_en: Show reverence and adoration for a deity or sacred object.
examples: Devotees gather at the pagoda to worship on full moon nights.

words.definition_vi: Lễ hội giao lưu đa văn hóa quốc tế
words.definition_en: A cultural festival celebrating international arts, cuisine, and harmony.
examples: The city hosted a lively xenophile-festival with sixty national pavilions.

words.definition_vi: Cầu chúc phúc lộc bình an năm mới
words.definition_en: Impart auspicious wishes of prosperity and health.
examples: Elders yield-blessings and lucky money to children during Tet.

words.definition_vi: Cung hoàng đạo / 12 con giáp
words.definition_en: A belt of the heavens divided into twelve signs, each named for a constellation.
examples: The Lunar New Year ushered in the auspicious Year of the Dragon in zodiac.

words.definition_vi: Bàn thờ gia tiên / bàn thờ thần linh
words.definition_en: A table or flat-topped block used as the focus for a religious ritual.
examples: Fresh incense and chrysanthemums were placed on the ancestral altar.

words.definition_vi: Chợ phiên lễ hội ngoài trời
words.definition_en: A market in a Middle Eastern or Asian country, or fundraising sale.
examples: Tourists wandered through the vibrant spice and textile bazaar.

words.definition_vi: Trang phục truyền thống / lễ phục
words.definition_en: A set of clothes in a style typical of a particular country or period.
examples: Dancers wore colorful silk traditional costumes during the performance.

words.definition_vi: Múa lân rồng mừng lễ hội
words.definition_en: A traditional dance and performance in Chinese culture for good fortune.
examples: A massive 50-meter glowing dragon dance swept through Chinatown.

words.definition_vi: Hình nộm làm bằng rơm/giấy trong lễ hội
words.definition_en: A sculpture or model of a person, made to be burned in a festival.
examples: In the festival, villagers burn the winter effigy to welcome spring.

words.definition_vi: Bài hát dân ca truyền thống
words.definition_en: A song that originates in traditional popular culture.
examples: The ensemble performed lyrical Quan Ho folk songs with wooden flutes.

words.definition_vi: Đại nhạc hội dạ tiệc lễ hội
words.definition_en: A social occasion with special entertainments or performances.
examples: The charity foundation hosted an elegant Lunar New Year gala.
