examples: The wise old mentor is a universal mythological archetype.

words.definition_vi: Thuyết hành vi tâm lý học
words.definition_en: The theory that human behavior can be explained in terms of conditioning.
examples: B.F. Skinner conducted pioneering experiments in psychological behaviorism.

words.definition_vi: Nhận thức và tư duy trí não
words.definition_en: The mental action or process of acquiring knowledge and understanding through thought.
examples: Puzzles and languages stimulate mental cognition in aging adults.

words.definition_vi: Thuyết tất định (Mọi sự đều do tiền định)
words.definition_en: The doctrine that all events are determined by causes external to the will.
examples: Philosophers debate the tension between free will and strict determinism.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa hiện sinh
words.definition_en: A philosophical approach emphasizing individual existence, freedom, and choice.
examples: Sartre and Camus were celebrated thinkers of mid-century existentialism.

words.definition_vi: Trạng thái dòng chảy (Tập trung thăng hoa)
words.definition_en: A state of complete absorption and energized focus in an activity.
examples: Musicians and athletes perform at their peak when entering a flow state.

words.definition_vi: Lòng biết ơn, sự tri ân
words.definition_en: The quality of being thankful; readiness to show appreciation.
examples: Writing a daily gratitude journal significantly boosts life happiness.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa khoái lạc hưởng thụ
words.definition_en: The pursuit of pleasure; sensual self-indulgence.
examples: Philosophical hedonism argues that pleasure is the ultimate human good.

words.definition_vi: Sự tự nội quan, soi rọi nội tâm
words.definition_en: The examination or observation of one's own mental and emotional processes.
examples: Quiet meditation provides an opportunity for deep personal introspection.

words.definition_vi: Khả năng phán đoán / Phán xét
words.definition_en: The ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions.
examples: Mindfulness meditation teaches observing thoughts without harsh judgment.

words.definition_vi: Luật nhân quả nghiệp báo
words.definition_en: The sum of a person's actions in this and previous states of existence.
examples: Believers in karma believe that good deeds inevitably bring good fortune.

words.definition_vi: Sự sáng suốt, minh mẫn tinh thần
words.definition_en: Clarity of expression; intelligibility; the ability to think clearly.
examples: In a moment of sudden mental lucidity, the solution became obvious.

words.definition_vi: Sự chánh niệm, tỉnh thức hiện tại
words.definition_en: The quality or state of being conscious or aware of something in present moment.
examples: Mindfulness breathing exercises reduce cortisol stress levels quickly.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa hư vô (Phủ nhận ý nghĩa cuộc sống)
words.definition_en: The rejection of all religious and moral principles, belief that life is meaningless.
examples: Nietzsche analyzed the cultural consequences of European nihilism.

words.definition_vi: Bản thể luận triết học
words.definition_en: The branch of metaphysics dealing with the nature of being.
examples: Ontology explores fundamental questions about what it means to exist.

words.definition_vi: Phân tâm học (Sigmund Freud)
words.definition_en: A system of psychological theory and therapy treating mental disorders through unconscious mind.
examples: Freud developed clinical psychoanalysis to uncover repressed memories.

words.definition_vi: Cảm giác bản thể chủ quan (Triết học tâm trí)
words.definition_en: Individual instances of subjective, conscious experience (e.g. the redness of red).
examples: Philosophers of mind debate how neural firings produce subjective qualia.

words.definition_vi: Khả năng kiên cường phục hồi tinh thần
words.definition_en: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.
examples: Psychological resilience allows individuals to adapt following trauma.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa khắc kỷ (Marcus Aurelius)
words.definition_en: The endurance of pain or hardship without display of feelings and without complaint.
examples: Stoicism teaches focusing exclusively on what is within our control.

words.definition_vi: Sự siêu việt, vượt lên trên giới hạn
words.definition_en: Existence or experience beyond the normal or physical level.
examples: Deep meditation can lead to profound moments of spiritual transcendence.

words.definition_vi: Tầng tiềm thức / vô thức
words.definition_en: The part of the mind which is inaccessible to the conscious mind.
examples: Dreams reveal the hidden symbolic desires of the human unconscious.

words.definition_vi: Đức hạnh, phẩm hạnh tốt lành
words.definition_en: Behavior showing high moral standards.
examples: Patience, compassion, and courage are classical human virtues.

words.definition_vi: Trí tuệ, sự thông thái
words.definition_en: The quality of having experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
examples: With age and deep reflection comes emotional maturity and wisdom.

words.definition_vi: Tâm lý học trí tuệ ngoài hành tinh / trí tuệ nhân tạo
words.definition_en: The study of extraterrestrial or synthetic non-human minds.
examples: Sci-fi authors and AI researchers explore concepts of xenopsychology.

words.definition_vi: Thuyết âm dương hòa hợp
words.definition_en: Two complementary principles of Chinese philosophy (dark/light, passive/active).
examples: The concept of yin-yang illustrates the balance of opposing cosmic forces.

words.definition_vi: Triết lý tư tưởng thời đại
words.definition_en: Philosophical thought reflecting the existential questions of an era.
examples: Postmodernism emerged as the defining zeitgeist-philosophy of late 20th century.

words.definition_vi: Lòng vị tha vô tư
words.definition_en: The belief in or practice of disinterested and selfless concern for the well-being of others.
examples: Biological altruism benefits the survival of social species.

words.definition_vi: Thiên kiến nhận thức (Cognitive Bias)
words.definition_en: Prejudice in favor of or against one thing, person, or group.
examples: Confirmation bias leads people to seek only facts that confirm their beliefs.

words.definition_vi: Sự giải tỏa dồn nén cảm xúc
words.definition_en: The process of releasing, and thereby providing relief from, strong or repressed emotions.
examples: Weeping openly during the tragic drama provided an emotional catharsis.

words.definition_vi: Thuyết nhị nguyên (Thân xác & Tâm trí tách biệt)
words.definition_en: The division of something conceptually into two opposed or contrasted aspects.
examples: Cartesian dualism posits that the mind and body are fundamentally distinct substances.

words.definition_vi: Nhận thức luận triết học
words.definition_en: The theory of knowledge, especially with regard to its methods, validity, and scope.
examples: Epistemology asks how we know what we know to be genuinely true.

words.definition_vi: Ngụy biện logic trong lập luận
words.definition_en: A mistaken belief, especially one based on unsound argument.
examples: Attacking someone's character rather than their point is an ad hominem fallacy.

words.definition_vi: Tâm lý học Gestalt (Cái toàn thể lớn hơn tổng các phần)
words.definition_en: An organized whole that is perceived as more than the sum of its parts.
examples: Gestalt psychology demonstrates how human visual perception groups shapes.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa nhân văn đề cao con người
words.definition_en: A rationalist outlook attaching prime importance to human rather than divine matters.
examples: Renaissance humanism sparked a revival of classical learning and science.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa duy tâm / Tính lý tưởng hóa
words.definition_en: The practice of forming or pursuing ideals, especially unrealistically.
examples: Her youthful political idealism matured into pragmatic leadership.

words.definition_vi: Thuộc trường phái tâm lý học Carl Jung
words.definition_en: Relating to the psychological theories of Carl Gustav Jung.
examples: Jungian shadow work helps individuals integrate unacknowledged parts of self.

words.definition_vi: Số phận tiền định, định mệnh
words.definition_en: Destiny; fate.
examples: Meeting her future husband in a random bookstore felt like pure kismet.

words.definition_vi: Tư duy logic, lý luận hợp lý
words.definition_en: Reasoning conducted or assessed according to strict principles of validity.
examples: Aristotelian formal logic establishes valid syllogistic deduction.

words.definition_vi: Siêu nhận thức (Tư duy về chính tư duy của mình)
words.definition_en: Awareness and understanding of one's own thought processes.
examples: Developing metacognition helps students evaluate their learning strategies.

words.definition_vi: Khả năng tái cấu trúc của não bộ
words.definition_en: The ability of the brain to form and reorganize synaptic connections.
examples: Learning complex new skills harnesses adult neuroplasticity.

words.definition_vi: Thái độ lạc quan yêu đời
words.definition_en: Hopefulness and confidence about the future or successful outcome.
examples: Cultivating learned optimism improves cardiovascular health and resilience.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa thực dụng hành động hiệu quả
words.definition_en: An approach that assesses the truth of meaning of theories in terms of success of practical application.
examples: American pragmatism measures ideas by their real-world consequences.

words.definition_vi: Thuyết tĩnh lặng tâm linh tuyệt đối
words.definition_en: Calm acceptance of things as they are, without attempting to resist.
examples: Eastern meditative philosophies practice forms of spiritual quietism.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa duy lý (Tôn sùng lý trí)
words.definition_en: A belief or theory that opinions and actions should be based on reason rather than religious belief.
examples: Enlightenment rationalism emphasized reason over blind dogma.

words.definition_vi: Thuyết duy ngã (Chỉ có tâm trí mình tồn tại)
words.definition_en: The view or theory that the self is all that can be known to exist.
examples: Extreme philosophical solipsism questions the reality of external world.

words.definition_vi: Mục đích luận (Vạn vật tồn tại đều có mục đích)
words.definition_en: The explanation of phenomena in terms of the purpose they serve rather than cause.
examples: Aristotle's physics applied teleology to natural biological functions.

words.definition_vi: Chủ nghĩa công lợi (Điều tốt nhất cho số đông)
words.definition_en: The doctrine that actions are right if they are useful or for benefit of majority.
examples: Utilitarianism seeks the greatest happiness for the greatest number.

words.definition_vi: Ý chí tự do, sự tự nguyện
words.definition_en: The faculty or power of using one's will.
examples: She resigned from the corporate board of her own free volition.

words.definition_vi: Thế giới quan nhân sinh quan
words.definition_en: A particular philosophy of life or conception of the world.
examples: Traveling widely broadens one's cultural and philosophical worldview.

words.definition_vi: Tâm thế đỉnh cao sáng suốt thanh tịnh
words.definition_en: A mental state of pristine clarity, peace, and cognitive mastery.
examples: Meditation masters attain a calm and unshakeable zenith-mind.

description: Động vật hoang dã, sinh vật biển và bảo tồn tự nhiên

words.definition_vi: Động vật lưỡng cư (Ếch, cóc, kỳ giông)
words.definition_en: A cold-blooded vertebrate animal of a class that comprises the frogs, toads, newts.
examples: Frogs and salamanders are vulnerable amphibians sensitive to pollution.

words.definition_vi: Hiện tượng sinh vật tự phát quang
words.definition_en: The biochemical emission of light by living organisms such as fireflies.
examples: Deep-sea jellyfish and anglerfish use bioluminescence to lure prey in the dark.

words.definition_vi: Động vật ăn thịt
words.definition_en: An animal that feeds primarily or exclusively on flesh.
examples: Lions, tigers, and wolves are apex mammalian carnivores.

words.definition_vi: Thuộc về phần vây lưng của cá
words.definition_en: Relating to the upper side or back of an animal, plant, or organ.
examples: The shark's sharp dorsal fin sliced through the ocean surface.

words.definition_vi: Khả năng định vị bằng sóng siêu âm
words.definition_en: The location of objects by reflected sound, in particular by dolphins and bats.
examples: Bats navigate pitch-black caves effortlessly using high-frequency echolocation.

words.definition_vi: Quần thể động vật học
words.definition_en: The animals of a particular region, habitat, or geological period.
examples: The African savannah is home to an extraordinary variety of wild fauna.

words.definition_vi: Mang cá thở dưới nước
words.definition_en: The paired respiratory organ of fishes and some amphibians by which oxygen is extracted.
examples: Fish absorb dissolved oxygen from water through their delicate gills.

words.definition_vi: Động vật ăn thực vật
words.definition_en: An animal that feeds on plants.
examples: Elephants, giraffes, and deer are large herbivore species.

words.definition_vi: Động vật không xương sống (Côn trùng, sứa)
words.definition_en: An animal lacking a backbone, such as an arthropod, mollusk, annelid.
examples: Over 95% of all animal species on Earth are classified as invertebrates.

words.definition_vi: Con sứa biển
words.definition_en: A free-swimming marine coelenterate with a gelatinous bell-shaped body.
examples: Swimmers avoided the bay due to a swarm of stinging box jellyfish.

words.definition_vi: Loài nhuyễn thể krill (Thức ăn của cá voi)
words.definition_en: Small shrimplike planktonic crustaceans of the open seas.
examples: Blue whales consume up to four tons of Antarctic krill each day.

words.definition_vi: Ấu trùng côn trùng
words.definition_en: The active immature form of an insect, especially one that differs from the adult.
examples: The butterfly larva transforms into a chrysalis before emerging.

words.definition_vi: Động vật có vú nuôi con bằng sữa
words.definition_en: A warm-blooded vertebrate animal distinguished by the possession of hair, milk secretion.
examples: Whales and dolphins are marine mammals that breathe atmospheric air.

words.definition_vi: Hoạt động kiếm ăn về đêm
words.definition_en: Done, occurring, or active at night.
examples: Owls and raccoons are nocturnal predators with acute night vision.

words.definition_vi: Động vật ăn tạp (Ăn cả thịt và thực vật)
words.definition_en: An animal or person that eats food of both plant and animal origin.
examples: Bears and chimpanzees are highly adaptable natural omnivores.

words.definition_vi: Động vật săn mồi
words.definition_en: An animal that naturally preys on others.
examples: The snow leopard is an elusive apex predator of the high Himalayas.

words.definition_vi: Động vật bốn chân
words.definition_en: An animal which has four feet, especially an ungulate mammal.
examples: Horses and dogs are four-legged quadrupeds.

words.definition_vi: Động vật bò sát (Trăn, thằn lằn, rùa)
words.definition_en: A vertebrate animal of a class that includes snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles.
examples: Reptiles are cold-blooded vertebrates with scales that lay eggs on land.

words.definition_vi: Mối quan hệ cộng sinh tương hỗ
words.definition_en: Interaction between two different organisms living in close physical association.
examples: The clownfish and sea anemone live in mutual beneficial symbiosis.

words.definition_vi: Tua cuốn, xúc tu (Mực, bạch tuộc)
words.definition_en: A slender, flexible limb or appendage in an animal, especially around mouth.
examples: The giant octopus grasped the rock with suction cups along its tentacles.

words.definition_vi: Động vật có móng guốc (Ngựa, hươu, bò)
words.definition_en: A hoofed mammal, comprising artiodactyls and perissodactyls.
examples: Zebras and antelopes are migratory African ungulates.

words.definition_vi: Có nọc độc nguy hiểm khi cắn/chích
words.definition_en: Capable of injecting venom by means of a bite or sting.
examples: The inland taipan is the world's most venomous land snake.

words.definition_vi: Cá voi khổng lồ
words.definition_en: A very large marine mammal with a streamlined hairless body.
examples: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth.

words.definition_vi: Bộ thú có khớp lạ (Con lười, thú ăn kiến)
words.definition_en: A major clade of placental mammals comprising armadillos, anteaters, and sloths.
examples: Sloths and armadillos belong to the ancient South American Xenarthra order.

words.definition_vi: Nhượng lại lãnh thổ săn mồi khi thua trận
words.definition_en: Surrender habitat or hunting domain to a dominant rival.
examples: The defeated male wolf yielded territory to the younger challenger.

words.definition_vi: Sinh vật phù du động vật biển
words.definition_en: Plankton consisting of small animals and the immature stages of larger animals.
examples: Basking sharks filter millions of microscopic zooplankton from ocean currents.

words.definition_vi: Sự thích nghi tiến hóa sinh tồn
words.definition_en: A change or the process of change by which an organism becomes better suited to its environment.
examples: Camouflage is an evolutionary adaptation for predator evasion.

words.definition_vi: Tấm sừng lọc thức ăn của cá voi
words.definition_en: Whalebone plates in the mouth of baleen whales used to strain krill.
examples: Baleen whales filter ocean water through dense keratinous bristles.

words.definition_vi: Sự ngụy trang hòa vào môi trường
words.definition_en: The disguising of military personnel or animals by blending in with surroundings.
examples: Chameleons change skin color for mating display and natural camouflage.

words.definition_vi: Sinh vật ăn mùn bã phân hủy rác tự nhiên
words.definition_en: An animal which feeds on dead organic material, especially plant detritus.
examples: Earthworms and sea cucumbers act as vital ecosystem detritivores.

words.definition_vi: Bộ xương ngoài cứng (Cua, tôm, côn trùng)
words.definition_en: A rigid external covering for the body in some invertebrate animals.
examples: Crabs and lobsters molt their hard chitinous exoskeleton as they grow.

words.definition_vi: Chim non mới tập bay
words.definition_en: A young bird that has just fledged or developed wing feathers.
examples: The parent eagles guarded their fledgling as it attempted its first flight.

words.definition_vi: Thời kỳ mang thai của động vật có vú
words.definition_en: The process of carrying or being carried in the womb between conception and birth.
examples: Asian elephants have the longest gestation period of any mammal (22 months).

words.definition_vi: Kỳ ngủ đông tránh rét
words.definition_en: The state of inactivity and metabolic depression in animals during winter.
examples: Bears enter deep winter hibernation to conserve energy.

words.definition_vi: Bản năng sinh tồn tự nhiên
words.definition_en: An innate, typically fixed pattern of behavior in animals in response to stimuli.
examples: Sea turtle hatchlings crawl toward the ocean guided by primal instinct.

words.definition_vi: Cá thể động vật con chưa trưởng thành
words.definition_en: A young animal not yet fully grown.
examples: Juvenile sea turtles spend years floating in open pelagic ocean currents.

words.definition_vi: Động vật săn mồi đầu chuỗi bảo vệ cân bằng sinh thái
words.definition_en: A predator whose presence regulates the population of all other species.
examples: Reintroducing wolves to Yellowstone restored its keystone predator role.

words.definition_vi: Sự phát quang sinh học
words.definition_en: The emission of light by a substance not resulting from heat.
examples: Deep ocean trenches glow with the eerie green luminescence of comb jellies.

words.definition_vi: Cuộc di cư theo mùa của đàn thú/chim
words.definition_en: Seasonal movement of animals from one region to another.
examples: The Serengeti wildebeest migration is one of nature's greatest spectacles.

words.definition_vi: Tế bào châm nọc của sứa và san hô
words.definition_en: A specialized cell in coelenterates containing a barbed, venomous thread.
examples: Jellyfish tentacles fire microscopic nematocysts upon physical contact.

words.definition_vi: Đẻ trứng (Chim, bò sát)
words.definition_en: Producing young by means of eggs that are hatched after they have been laid by parent.
examples: Birds, reptiles, and most fish are oviparous species.

words.definition_vi: Sinh vật phù du trôi nổi trên biển
words.definition_en: The small and microscopic organisms drifting or floating in the sea or freshwater.
examples: Phytoplankton and zooplankton form the foundational base of marine food webs.

words.definition_vi: Ong chúa đầu đàn
words.definition_en: A single fertile female bee in a colony, laying thousands of eggs daily.
examples: Worker bees nurse and protect the fertile queen-bee inside the hive.

words.definition_vi: Nơi chim/dơi đậu ngủ đêm
words.definition_en: A place where birds or bats regularly settle or congregate to rest.
examples: Hundreds of fruit bats hung upside down in their cave roost.

words.definition_vi: Động vật ăn xác thối dọn dẹp tự nhiên
words.definition_en: An animal that feeds on carrion, dead plant material, or refuse.
examples: Vultures and hyenas perform a vital sanitary role as scavengers.

words.definition_vi: Bảo vệ lãnh thổ quyết liệt
words.definition_en: Relating to the ownership of an area of land or sea, fiercely defended.
examples: Male tigers are fiercely territorial and mark their forest boundaries.

words.definition_vi: Dưới đáy đại dương / Dưới mặt nước
words.definition_en: Situated, occurring, or done beneath the surface of the water.
examples: Scuba divers explored the vibrant underwater coral garden.

words.definition_vi: Đẻ con nuôi bằng nhau thai (Động vật có vú)
words.definition_en: Bringing forth live young that have developed inside the body of the parent.
examples: Humans, dogs, and dolphins are viviparous mammals.

words.definition_vi: Động vật máu nóng hằng nhiệt
words.definition_en: Maintaining a constant body temperature independent of environment.
examples: Mammals and birds are warm-blooded vertebrates.

words.definition_vi: Bay lượn tít trên tầng trời cao đỉnh
words.definition_en: Gliding at extreme high altitude on thermal updrafts.
examples: The golden eagle is celebrated for its majestic zenith-soaring flight.

description: Tinh thần khởi nghiệp, gọi vốn và đổi mới đột phá

words.definition_vi: Vườn ươm tăng tốc khởi nghiệp
words.definition_en: An organization or program that provides mentoring, investment to startups.
examples: Y Combinator is the world's most renowned startup accelerator.

words.definition_vi: Tự thân khởi nghiệp không nhận vốn ngoài
words.definition_en: Starting and growing a business using only personal savings and initial revenue.
examples: The founders bootstrapped the software firm to profitability in two years.

words.definition_vi: Gọi vốn cộng đồng
words.definition_en: The practice of funding a project by raising small amounts of money from many people.
examples: The team raised $1 million on Kickstarter through crowdfunding.

words.definition_vi: Sự đổi mới đột phá thay đổi toàn ngành
words.definition_en: Radical change to an existing industry or market through technological innovation.
examples: Digital streaming caused massive market disruption to traditional video rentals.

words.definition_vi: Doanh nhân khởi nghiệp
words.definition_en: A person who sets up a business, taking on financial risks in the hope of profit.
examples: Elon Musk is a visionary technology entrepreneur.

words.definition_vi: Sự thành lập sáng lập công ty
words.definition_en: The act of starting or establishing a company, institution, or project.
examples: The co-founders celebrated the tenth anniversary of the company's founding.

words.definition_vi: Chiến lược tăng trưởng thần tốc với chi phí tối ưu
words.definition_en: Rapid experimentation across marketing and product development to acquire users.
examples: Dropbox used referral storage bonuses as an effective growth hacking tactic.

words.definition_vi: Trung tâm khởi nghiệp công nghệ
words.definition_en: The effective center of an activity, region, or network.
examples: Silicon Valley remains the global innovation hub for tech startups.

words.definition_vi: Trung tâm ươm tạo ý tưởng kinh doanh
words.definition_en: An organization that helps early-stage companies to develop by providing services.
examples: The university launched an AI startup incubator on campus.

words.definition_vi: Cổ phần chia sẻ giữa các đồng sáng lập
words.definition_en: Shares distributed among co-founders in a venture.
examples: The partners agreed on equal joint-equity distribution in the founders agreement.

words.definition_vi: Cơ sở tri thức tài liệu của startup
words.definition_en: An underlying set of facts, analysis, and data available to a system.
examples: Startups maintain a centralized knowledge-base for customer onboarding.

words.definition_vi: Phương pháp khởi nghiệp tinh gọn (Eric Ries)
words.definition_en: A methodology for developing businesses and products that aims to shorten cycles.
examples: The lean startup framework emphasizes rapid iterative prototyping.

words.definition_vi: Sản phẩm khả dụng tối thiểu (MVP)
words.definition_en: A version of a product with just enough features to be usable by early customers.
examples: We launched a minimum viable product to validate customer demand.

words.definition_vi: Kỹ năng kết nối mạng lưới đối tác
words.definition_en: The action or process of interacting with others to exchange info and develop contacts.
examples: Founder networking events at tech summits open doors to angel investors.

words.definition_vi: Đổi mới sáng tạo mở hợp tác đa bên
words.definition_en: A business management model for innovation that promotes collaboration.
examples: Corporations adopt open-innovation by partnering with nimble AI startups.

words.definition_vi: Chuyển hướng chiến lược kinh doanh
words.definition_en: Change the direction of a business or product based on customer feedback.
examples: Instagram pivoted from a location check-in app to a photo-sharing platform.

words.definition_vi: Bước nhảy vọt đột phá công nghệ
words.definition_en: A huge, often sudden increase or advance in something.
examples: Generative AI represents a quantum-leap in digital productivity.

words.definition_vi: Thời gian sống còn của startup dựa trên số tiền còn lại
words.definition_en: The amount of time a startup company has before it runs out of cash.
examples: With $600,000 in the bank and monthly burn of $50,000, our runway is 12 months.

words.definition_vi: Vòng gọi vốn hạt giống (Seed Round)
words.definition_en: The earliest round of venture capital investment in an early startup.
examples: The fintech team closed a $2 million seed round led by venture funds.

words.definition_vi: Đà tăng trưởng người dùng / doanh thu thực tế
words.definition_en: The extent to which a product gains popularity or acceptance in market.
examples: The app gained viral user traction with 500,000 signups in month one.

words.definition_vi: Kỳ lân công nghệ (Định giá từ 1 tỷ USD)
words.definition_en: A privately held startup company valued at over $1 billion.
examples: The payment processing platform became the nation's newest tech unicorn.

words.definition_vi: Quỹ đầu tư mạo hiểm mạo hiểm (VC)
words.definition_en: Capital invested in a project in which there is a substantial element of risk.
examples: Venture capital firms invest in high-growth technology startups.

words.definition_vi: Sách trắng công bố giải pháp công nghệ
words.definition_en: An authoritative report explaining complex product mechanics to investors.
examples: The blockchain startup published an in-depth cryptographic white-paper.

words.definition_vi: Hệ sinh thái khởi nghiệp thân thiện, hỗ trợ tối đa
words.definition_en: A welcoming, highly supportive regional startup environment.
examples: The city fostered a vibrant, highly xenial-ecosystem for international founders.

words.definition_vi: Mức định giá doanh nghiệp dựa trên tiềm năng sinh lời
words.definition_en: Startup valuation derived from projected cash flow and multiple multiples.
examples: Investors agreed on a $25 million post-money yield-valuation.

words.definition_vi: Khát khao sáng tạo đổi mới không ngừng
words.definition_en: Intense passion and drive to invent groundbreaking solutions.
examples: Her relentless zeal-for-innovation led to three registered patents.

words.definition_vi: Nhà đầu tư thiên thần (Đầu tư giai đoạn đầu)
words.definition_en: An affluent individual who provides capital for a business start-up.
examples: The angel investor provided $150,000 in pre-seed funding for a 5% stake.

words.definition_vi: Tốc độ tiêu tiền hàng tháng của startup
words.definition_en: The rate at which an enterprise spends its capital before generating positive cash flow.
examples: Managing monthly burn rate ensures the startup doesn't run out of cash.

words.definition_vi: Đồng sáng lập viên
words.definition_en: A person who establishes an organization together with one or more other people.
examples: The two technical co-founders met in university computer science lab.

words.definition_vi: Ngày trình diễn sản phẩm trước các nhà đầu tư
words.definition_en: An event at which startup founders pitch their business to an audience of investors.
examples: Accelerators conclude their 3-month cohort with a high-stakes Demo Day.

words.definition_vi: Người dùng tiên phong thử nghiệm đầu tiên
words.definition_en: A person who starts using a product or technology as soon as it becomes available.
examples: Early adopters provided invaluable feedback that shaped the final UI design.

words.definition_vi: Thỏa thuận cổ đông sáng lập
words.definition_en: A legal contract establishing roles, equity splits, and vesting schedules.
examples: Draft a clear founders agreement before incorporating the company.

words.definition_vi: Chiến lược tung sản phẩm ra thị trường (GTM)
words.definition_en: A strategic plan on how a company will reach target customers and achieve advantage.
examples: The executive team presented a comprehensive go-to-market strategy.

words.definition_vi: Cuộc thi lập trình sáng tạo 24-48 giờ
words.definition_en: An event in which a large number of people meet to engage in collaborative computer programming.
examples: The startup's core algorithm was originally built during a weekend hackathon.

words.definition_vi: Giai đoạn hình thành và sàng lọc ý tưởng
words.definition_en: The capacity for or the act of forming or entertaining ideas.
examples: Design sprints begin with structured user research and team ideation.

words.definition_vi: Mối quan hệ hợp tác liên minh kinh doanh
words.definition_en: A formal commercial alliance between two or more enterprises.
examples: The startup established a joint-partnership with a multinational logistics firm.

words.definition_vi: Bài thuyết trình gọi vốn đỉnh cao
words.definition_en: A high-impact onstage presentation to venture capitalists.
examples: The founder delivered a captivating keynote-pitch at TechCrunch Disrupt.

words.definition_vi: Cấp phép bản quyền sở hữu trí tuệ
words.definition_en: The granting of a license for use of intellectual property in exchange for royalties.
examples: The biotech startup generates revenue by licensing patented molecules.

words.definition_vi: Sự phù hợp giữa sản phẩm và thị trường (Product-Market Fit)
words.definition_en: Being in a good market with a product that can satisfy that market.
examples: Achieving product market fit is the primary milestone for any early startup.

words.definition_vi: Nguồn vốn không làm mất cổ phần (Tài trợ chính phủ)
words.definition_en: Funding that does not require giving up equity or ownership in the company.
examples: Government innovation grants provide valuable non-dilutive startup funding.

words.definition_vi: Quỹ quyền chọn cổ phiếu thưởng cho nhân viên (ESOP)
words.definition_en: Shares set aside for future employees to attract top talent.
examples: The board allocated a 15% employee stock option pool.

words.definition_vi: Bản slide thuyết trình dự án gọi vốn
words.definition_en: A brief presentation used to provide investors with a quick overview of business plan.
examples: A compelling 10-slide pitch deck highlights the problem, solution, and traction.

words.definition_vi: Cú chuyển hướng nhanh thích ứng thị trường
words.definition_en: An agile, rapid modification of business model in response to market signals.
examples: The team executed a quick-pivot to remote software tools when lockdowns hit.

words.definition_vi: Đường cong giữ chân người dùng
words.definition_en: A visual graph depicting what percentage of users continue to use an app over time.
examples: A flattening retention-curve proves that the product delivers real lasting value.

words.definition_vi: Khả năng mở rộng quy mô không giới hạn
words.definition_en: The capacity to be changed in size or scale, handle growing amounts of work.
examples: Software-as-a-service offers infinite scalability with zero marginal cost.

words.definition_vi: Bản điều khoản thỏa thuận đầu tư (VC)
words.definition_en: A non-binding agreement showing the basic terms and conditions of an investment.
examples: The founders received three competing term sheets from Silicon Valley VCs.

words.definition_vi: Tiềm năng sinh lời tăng trưởng vượt trội
words.definition_en: The prospective increase in value or profitability of an asset or startup.
examples: Venture capitalists look for asymmetric upside-potential in early-stage bets.

words.definition_vi: Cơ chế trao quyền sở hữu cổ phần theo thời gian
words.definition_en: The process by which an employee accrues non-forfeitable rights to employer-provided stock.
examples: The standard startup equity agreement includes a 4-year vesting schedule with a 1-year cliff.

words.definition_vi: Sản phẩm gắn thương hiệu tùy chỉnh (Gia công OEM)
words.definition_en: A product or service produced by one company that other companies rebrand as their own.
examples: The fintech platform offers white-label digital banking apps to credit unions.

words.definition_vi: Tạo ra cái mới hoàn toàn từ số 0 (Peter Thiel)
words.definition_en: Creating something genuinely new rather than copying what already exists.
examples: True innovation takes humanity from zero-to-one rather than 1 to n.

topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
description: Thành ngữ, cụm động từ tự nhiên và tiếng lóng bản xứ

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Cắn răng chịu đựng quyết định làm việc khó
words.definition_en: Decide to do something difficult or unpleasant that one has been putting off.
examples: I finally bit the bullet and enrolled in the intensive speaking course.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Phá vỡ bầu không khí ngượng ngùng ban đầu
words.definition_en: Do or say something to relieve tension or get conversation going.
examples: Telling a lighthearted joke helped break the ice during the interview.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Dừng làm việc, nghỉ ngơi kết thúc ngày
words.definition_en: Stop working on something, especially after a long and productive period.
examples: We have made tremendous progress today, so let's call it a day.
collocations: time to call it a day

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Ghé tạt qua chơi chốc lát
words.definition_en: Visit informally and spontaneously.
examples: Feel free to drop by my office if you have any pronunciation questions.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Tìm ra giải pháp / Hiểu ra vấn đề
words.definition_en: Discover, determine, or solve something through thought.
examples: It took me three days to figure out the solution to the programming bug.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Hòa thuận, ăn ý với nhau
words.definition_en: Have a harmonious or friendly relationship.
examples: The new team members get along wonderfully with everyone.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Cắm đầu vào học bài chăm chỉ
words.definition_en: Begin to study hard and seriously.
examples: I have final exams next week, so I need to hit the books tonight.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nói tóm lại một cách ngắn gọn súc tích
words.definition_en: In the fewest possible words; summarized clearly.
examples: In a nutshell, consistent daily practice is the secret to English fluency.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Chạy theo trào lưu số đông
words.definition_en: Join others in doing something that is currently fashionable or popular.
examples: Many tech firms jumped on the AI bandwagon to attract investors.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Để mắt trông chừng, theo dõi sát
words.definition_en: Keep under careful observation or surveillance.
examples: Please keep an eye on my backpack while I grab a cup of coffee.
collocations: keep an eye on the time

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Háo hức mong đợi điều gì
words.definition_en: Await an event with anticipation and pleasure.
examples: I truly look forward to our speaking practice session tomorrow.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Đưa ra quyết định dứt khoát
words.definition_en: Make a definitive decision about something.
examples: He couldn't make up his mind between studying in London or Sydney.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Quyết định quá dễ dàng, không cần suy nghĩ
words.definition_en: Something that requires little or no mental effort to understand or decide.
examples: Accepting a full scholarship to Cambridge was an absolute no-brainer.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Phân vân chưa quyết định được ngả nào
words.definition_en: Undecided or neutral between two opinions or courses of action.
examples: I am still on the fence about whether to change my career path.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Dễ như ăn kẹo, cực kỳ đơn giản
words.definition_en: Something very easy to do.
examples: Don't worry about the grammar test; it will be a piece of cake.
collocations: easy as a piece of cake

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Hết sạch cạn kiệt thứ gì
words.definition_en: Exhaust the supply of something.
examples: We ran out of coffee beans, so I went to the supermarket.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Đồng quan điểm, nhất trí với nhau
words.definition_en: Be in full agreement with someone.
examples: My business partner and I see eye to eye on company values.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Coi điều gì là đương nhiên (Không biết trân trọng)
words.definition_en: Fail to properly appreciate someone or something, especially as a consequence of overfamiliarity.
examples: Never take your health and loving family for granted.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Cảm thấy hơi mệt mỏi khó ở trong người
words.definition_en: Slightly unwell or in low spirits.
examples: I felt a bit under the weather yesterday, so I rested in bed.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Tóm gọn và kết thúc thành công
words.definition_en: Complete or conclude a meeting or discussion successfully.
examples: Let's wrap up this meeting so everyone can enjoy their lunch.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Thức khuya làm việc/học bài miệt mài
words.definition_en: Read or work late into the night.
examples: Medical students burn the midnight oil during residency exams.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Làm ẩu, bớt xén quy trình để tiết kiệm
words.definition_en: Do something perfunctorily so as to save time or money.
examples: Never cut corners on electrical safety installations.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Bật mí bí mật bất ngờ
words.definition_en: Disclose a secret or reveal confidential information unintentionally.
examples: Don't spill the beans about Sarah's surprise birthday party.
synonyms: let the cat out of the bag

words.word: take with a grain of salt
words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nghe nửa tin nửa ngờ, có chọn lọc
words.definition_en: Regard something as exaggerated or only partially true.
examples: Take celebrity gossip in tabloid magazines with a grain of salt.
collocations: take with a grain of salt
take claims with grain of salt

words.word: hit the nail on the head
words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nói trúng phóc trọng tâm vấn đề
words.definition_en: Find the exact answer or identify a problem accurately.
examples: Her presentation hit the nail on the head regarding user retention.
collocations: you hit the nail on the head

words.word: cost an arm and a leg
words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Đắt đỏ cắt cổ
words.definition_en: Be extremely expensive.
examples: Designer luxury handbags cost an arm and a leg.
collocations: cost an arm and a leg

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Hiếm khi, năm thì mười họa mới xảy ra
words.definition_en: Very rarely; on rare occasions.
examples: He lives in London, so we only meet once in a blue moon.
collocations: happen once in a blue moon

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Cắt đứt mọi đường quay lại, tuyệt giao
words.definition_en: Destroy one's path, connections, or all possibility of retreat.
examples: Even when resigning, maintain polite relations and never burn bridges.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Trêu đùa, nói giỡn cho vui
words.definition_en: Deceive someone playfully as a joke.
examples: Don't be alarmed; I was just pulling your leg about the quiz.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Cùng nhau vượt qua mọi gian nan sóng gió
words.definition_en: Under all circumstances, no matter how difficult or challenging.
examples: True friends support each other through thick and thin.
collocations: stand by through thick and thin

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Hiểu lầm hướng đi / Nhắm sai mục tiêu
words.definition_en: Pursue a mistaken line of thought or course of action.
examples: If you think blaming him will solve the bug, you're barking up the wrong tree.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Trong cái rủi có cái may / Tái ông thất mã
words.definition_en: An apparent misfortune that eventually has good results.
examples: Losing that unfulfilling job turned out to be a blessing in disguise.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Vấn đề nổi cộm ai cũng biết nhưng né tránh
words.definition_en: An obvious major problem or issue that people avoid discussing.
examples: Corporate debt was the massive elephant in the room at the board meeting.
collocations: address the elephant in the room

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Làm mọi cách, tìm kiếm không bỏ sót ngóc ngách nào
words.definition_en: Try every possible course of action in order to achieve something.
examples: Detectives left no stone unturned in their search for the missing heir.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Đóng vai phản biện để thử thách lập luận
words.definition_en: Argue against an idea for the sake of exploring it thoroughly.
examples: Let me play devil's advocate: what if competitor prices drop by 50%?

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Từ nguồn tin trực tiếp xác thực nhất
words.definition_en: Directly from the person who has personal knowledge of the matter.
examples: I know the CEO is retiring because I heard it straight from the horse's mouth.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Chưa ngã ngũ, còn đang lơ lửng chưa chốt
words.definition_en: Uncertain, undecided, or not yet resolved.
examples: Our summer travel plans are still up in the air pending visa approval.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Chuyện cũ đã qua, bỏ qua không nhắc lại
words.definition_en: Past events that are no longer considered important or worth arguing about.
examples: We argued last year, but that's all water under the bridge now.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Rất phổ biến, đâu đâu cũng có
words.definition_en: Very common and of little special value.
examples: Generic smartphone cases are a dime a dozen at street markets.
collocations: ideas are a dime a dozen

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nói vòng vo tam quốc, không đi vào trọng tâm
words.definition_en: Discuss a matter without coming to the point directly.
examples: Please stop beating around the bush and tell me what really happened.

words.word: cross that bridge when you come to it
words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Tới đâu hay tới đó, lo việc trước mắt
words.definition_en: Deal with a problem if and when it actually arises.
examples: Let's not panic about next year's budget; we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
collocations: cross that bridge when we get to it

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Vượt ra ngoài tầm kiểm soát
words.definition_en: Become impossible to control or manage.
examples: The noisy street celebration got out of hand, so police stepped in.

words.word: kill two birds with one stone
words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Một mũi tên trúng hai đích (Một công đôi việc)
words.definition_en: Achieve two things with a single action.
examples: Listening to English podcasts while commuting kills two birds with one stone.
collocations: kill two birds with one stone

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nhìn vào mặt tích cực lạc quan
words.definition_en: Find good things in a bad situation.
examples: Even though the flight was delayed, look on the bright side: we have time to read.
collocations: always look on the bright side

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nói tóm lại câu chuyện dài
words.definition_en: Come to the point without lingering on minor details.
examples: To make a long story short, we caught the last train just in time.
collocations: to make a long story short

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nhanh nhẹn, tháo vát, nắm bắt tình hình tốt
words.definition_en: Alert, competent, and quick to understand or react to things.
examples: Our project coordinator is always on the ball with meeting deadlines.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Mưa như trút nước, mưa tầm tã
words.definition_en: Raining extremely heavily.
examples: Take your raincoat because it is raining cats and dogs outside.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Nhìn nhận bức tranh toàn cảnh chiến lược
words.definition_en: Understand the complete context and overall significance of a situation.
examples: Great leaders see the big picture rather than getting lost in small details.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Bấp bênh, nguy kịch khó đoán trước
words.definition_en: Precarious or uncertain in outcome.
examples: His medical condition was touch and go for two days after the surgery.

words.topic: Idioms, Phrasal Verbs & Slang for Speaking
words.definition_vi: Hoàn toàn đồng ý với bạn! Chuẩn không cần chỉnh!
words.definition_en: Used to express emphatic agreement with what someone has just said.
examples: 'This coffee is delicious!' - 'You can say that again!'
